title: Qualcomm Strikes AI Chip Deal With TikTok Owner ByteDance
summary: Qualcomm has secured a deal to supply AI-focused chips to ByteDance, owner of TikTok, for its data centers and AI agent software. This agreement is a significant win for Qualcomm as it seeks to expand its presence in the AI infrastructure market beyond its traditional smartphone processor business. ByteDance plans to purchase millions of Qualcomm's application-specific integrated circuits (ASICs), helping the company turn its in-house chip designs into production-ready semiconductors.

title: Regulating the AI Revolution: What Investors Need to Know
summary: The article discusses the regulatory landscape surrounding AI, focusing on strategic competition with China and domestic regulation in the U.S. It highlights U.S. efforts to restrict semiconductor exports to China and prevent technology transfer through investments, while also detailing voluntary commitments from AI developers in the U.S. aimed at safety, security, and transparency. This strategic offensive is expected to unlock significant growth potential for Qualcomm in the medium and long term, making its stock a promising asset for 2026.
